claims.claim: Chipotle’s business model is centered on company‑owned and partner‑operated restaurants that generate revenue directly from food and beverage sales.
claims.quote: As of December 31, 2025, we owned 3,938 Chipotle restaurants throughout the United States (“U.S.”) and 104 international Chipotle restaurants… Our revenue is derived from sales by our restaurants.

claims.claim: The company’s growth strategy, branded as the “Recipe for Growth,” focuses on accelerating restaurant expansion, modernizing technology, and sharpening competitiveness across five key areas.
claims.quote: Chipotle is a brand… Our Recipe for Growth strategy leans into what uniquely differentiates Chipotle, with a focus on accelerating growth and sharpening competitiveness.

claims.claim: A core pillar of the strategy is to modernize the business model with industry‑leading technology, including artificial intelligence and a relaunched rewards program, to improve the guest and team experience.
claims.quote: •Modernize our business model with industry-leading technology, including leveraging AI and relaunching our Rewards Program, to elevate the experience for our guests and teams;

claims.claim: Digital ordering and delivery are strategic growth drivers, accounting for more than a third of food and beverage revenue, with a focus on expanding the Chipotlane drive‑through format.
claims.quote: Our digital platform continues to be a strategic driver of our growth. Digital sales represented 36.7% of food and beverage revenue in 2025… we have made digital ordering convenient… by building more Chipotlanes, which is our drive through format for guest pick‑up of digital orders.

claims.claim: The fast‑casual, quick‑service, and casual dining sectors are highly competitive, with rivals competing on taste, price, food quality, service, location, and digital engagement.
claims.quote: The fast‑casual, quick-service, and casual dining segments of the restaurant industry are highly competitive… Competition includes… taste, price, food quality and presentation, customer service, location, convenience, brand reputation…

claims.claim: Chipotle’s emphasis on responsibly sourced ingredients and its “Responsibly Raised®” branding is intended to provide a differentiation advantage, though many competitors make similar quality claims.
claims.quote: We continue to believe our commitment to higher‑quality and responsibly sourced ingredients resonates with guests and gives us a competitive advantage; however, many of our competitors also make claims related to the quality of their ingredients…

claims.claim: In the third quarter of 2026 the company opened eighty‑four new company‑owned restaurants, including fifty‑three Chipotlanes, and five partner‑operated locations, highlighting ongoing expansion momentum.
claims.quote: Opened 84 company‑owned restaurants, with 53 locations including a Chipotlane. We also opened five international partner‑operated restaurants.

claims.claim: Management projects low‑single‑digit comparable restaurant sales growth for the full year 2026 and expects to open three hundred fifty to three hundred seventy new restaurants, most featuring Chipotlanes.
claims.quote: Full year comparable restaurant sales growth in the low single digit range… 350 to 370 new restaurant openings, which includes 10 to 15 international partner‑operated restaurants. Around 80% of new company‑owned restaurants will have a Chipotlane.

claims.claim: Sustainability is embedded in the brand promise, with all meat sourced under “Responsibly Raised®” standards and produce sourced according to Food with Integrity guidelines.
claims.quote: In Chipotle‑owned restaurants, we strive to serve only animal products that are raised in accordance with criteria… We brand our meats as “Responsibly Raised®.” We also seek to use responsibly grown produce…

claims.claim: The company mitigates commodity price volatility through forward contracts, diversified supplier bases, and direct procurement of key raw materials.
claims.quote: We try to mitigate future price risk through forward contracts, strong partnerships with key suppliers, directly managing key raw material procurement and diversifying our supply base and countries of origin; however, these activities may not fully insulate us from increases in costs…

claims.claim: Chipotle is heavily dependent on information‑technology systems for point‑of‑sale, digital ordering, supply‑chain tracing, and other core processes, exposing the business to cybersecurity and system‑failure risks.
claims.quote: We are heavily dependent on information technology systems… Our ability to effectively manage our business… depends significantly on the consistent availability, reliability and security of these systems.

claims.claim: The company invests in emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence and machine learning, though it acknowledges that these initiatives may not deliver expected efficiencies and could introduce new risks.
claims.quote: We continue to invest in and utilize emerging technologies… These new technologies may not deliver the expected efficiencies and could expose us to new risks…

gaps: The 10‑K does not provide a direct statement on the company’s overall market share relative to each named competitor; therefore a quantified competitive positioning claim cannot be made.
No specific forward‑looking guidance on international expansion beyond the brief mention of partner‑operated restaurants is provided in the excerpts; detailed development timelines are absent.
insight: Insight: Digital sales represented thirty‑six point seven percent of food and beverage revenue in 2025, underscoring the platform as a key growth catalyst — 10‑K line 208: "Our digital platform continues to be a strategic driver of our growth. Digital sales represented 36.7% of food and beverage revenue in 2025…"
